summary: Bond-vigilante selloff: Bessent's Treasury buyback failed to hold, 30Y rebounded to ~5.25% near 19-yr highs, Dow -700pts. Capital rotated into hard assets (crypto ETFs the only +3% flags, gold miners, energy) and out of high-multiple growth, defense (Ukraine peace) and premium retail (WMT -9.2%). Moderna -23.6% unwound its +177% cancer-vaccine pop; biotech now leads RS.
